name: vertical-clone
title: Vertical — Framer portfolio clone
description: Faithful visual clone of vertical.framer.media — a 14-section dark/green editorial portfolio with self-hosted Figtree + Fragment Mono fonts, 42 real photos, 3 background videos, and Lenis smooth scroll. Packaged from a finished Open Design project (index.html + styles.css + 107 harvested assets).

description_i18n.en: Faithful visual clone of vertical.framer.media — a 14-section dark/green editorial portfolio with self-hosted Figtree + Fragment Mono fonts, 42 real photos, 3 background videos, and Lenis smooth scroll. description_i18n.zh-CN: vertical.framer.media 的忠实视觉复刻——14 段深黑/电光绿编辑型作品集，自托管 Figtree + Fragment Mono 字体、42 张真实摄影、3 段背景视频，以及 Lenis 惯性滚动。由已完成的 Open Design 项目（index.html + styles.css + 107 个收获资产）打包而成。

query.en: Package the vertical.framer.media clone I just finished (index.html + styles.css + 107 harvested assets) as an Open Design plugin so I can install it into My plugins and open a PR to the Open Design community catalog.
